clean_negative_control.derivation: Tier C + live-equivalent NFE == 0 on EVERY historical ordinary-agent output + highest sixty-control modification accuracy. Result: 01_06 (ordinary NFE 0/0 outputs; sixty mod 0.9981). Any treatment!=control here, or any report firing here, is a harness perturbation artifact, not a mechanism effect.
clean_negative_control.purpose: validates specificity: the harness must not perturb clean trajectories. Expected: no report fires; treatment==control.

enrichment_declaration: This rule ENRICHES for detector contact/headroom. The first live study is a mechanism-discovery experiment, not a prevalence estimate. Contact rates and effect sizes from the discovery population must never be quoted as population prevalence.
forbidden_selectors: historical treatment improvement (no clean treatment history exists to select on)
gold formula identity (gold used only for retrospective precision/score columns, never for selection)
whether a prior feedback treatment succeeded

frozen_rule.call_budget: >=1 archived ordinary-agent control trajectory on the task with >=8 calls headroom after its first output write under a 50-call cap (all qualifying tasks pass with >=20; verified in repair_opportunity.json)
frozen_rule.freshness: not Tier A (contamination_audit.json); not in the reserved confirmation population (reserved_confirmation_population.json). Tier B allowed with pre-registered tier sensitivity analysis (recompute primary read excluding Tier-B tasks).
frozen_rule.rank: by (max ordinary NFE desc, n firing ordinary outputs desc, task id asc); take the top 7
frozen_rule.scaffold: historical ORDINARY-agent control (bash + view_xlsx + openpyxl; SWE-bash era or lx_helpers H0/C0 era). Calc-tools (297/Sol/K2.7) outputs must not qualify a task.
frozen_rule.threshold: max live-equivalent new_formula_error over the task's historical ordinary-agent control outputs >= 3
frozen_rule.valid_workbook: the qualifying historical output must be a valid, officially scoreable workbook

rule_type: GOLD-BLIND, CONTROL-SIDE. Every selector is computed from control-arm archives (workbooks, trajectories, contamination tiers) without opening goldens and without any treatment outcome.
threshold_justification: Observed ordinary-agent live-equivalent NFE is bimodal: 31 outputs at exactly 0, 14 outputs at >=3 (values 3, 4, 26-36, 147; NOTHING at 1-2). Threshold >=3 separates the modes exactly, keeps the small-but-real firings (10_05: 3; 04_09: 4), and guards against single-cell refire flukes. It is set from the control distribution shape, not from any treatment outcome.
yield: 7 enriched tasks {02_01, 02_06, 02_09, 04_09, 07_03, 10_05, 10_10} + 1 clean control {01_06} = 8. No 8th enriched task exists under this rule (next candidates are Tier A or zero-firing); N=10/12 cannot be filled honestly -- see proposed_discovery_population.json.
